title: Rank and Monotonic Trend Metrics Specification for MoS2 Contacts
rationale: Cross-lab systematic offsets shift absolute resistance values, but screening algorithms must accurately order contact strategies from best to worst.

metrics.name: spearman_rho
metrics.meaning: Monotonic ranking correlation across experimental devices.

metrics.name: kendall_tau
metrics.meaning: Net proportion of concordant pairwise metal comparisons.

metrics.name: concordance_index
metrics.meaning: Probability that the model correctly predicts which of two randomly chosen contacts has lower Rc.
